description.value: I Am Pho is a Vietnamese restaurant in Coquitlam emphasizing fresh, healthy dishes with a welcoming community focus. The restaurant operates out of a unit at 100 Schoolhouse Street and also has a second location in Surrey. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down dining option with takeout available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms I Am Pho is an active Vietnamese restaurant at #110-100 Schoolhouse St, Coquitlam, matching the OSM record. The site explicitly mentions takeout ('Take out, or any questions, please email to us') and provides a phone number (604-553-2909) not present in OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null.
concerns: Phone number 604-553-2909 found on website for the Coquitlam location but is absent from OSM tags — recommend adding to OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Vietnamese restaurant confirmed via website with takeout service — clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal stop in Coquitlam.
